title: Truncate long text with an ellipsis
why_it_matters: Long names and titles will break your layout if you don't plan for them.
explanation: Three rules together create a clean cut-off with three dots: no wrapping, hide the overflow, and set text-overflow. Inside flex items you also need min-width: 0, or the item refuses to shrink below its text.
try_it: Put a 60-character title inside a 200px card and apply these rules.
